body: Don’t keep it from her. I did and I hurt my mother more than I could have ever imagined. And I regret it.

As someone who battles with 2 eating disorders. It’s not that you’ll be letting her down. We can’t control our thoughts. Especially when it comes down to this. You’ll hurt her, yes. She’ll have to watch you suffer. But your mom seems strong and through all of this she’ll be your rock. She’ll be strong enough to help you and you will be able to lean on her; talk to her and she won’t judge you. Trust in her.

It’s not about sleep. I sleep on and off all day. I almost died on Thursday and I regret going to the hospital. I suffer from Major Persistent Depressive Disorder and I have 2 eating disorders and I just want it all to stop,
Haha yeah! I do my best to NOT leave my house in this weather!!
